verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official client-side SDKs. The quickstart uses Airwallex.js, the AI-agent instructions steer integrators to the official `@airwallex/components-sdk` package over the legacy `airwallex-payment-elements` library, and the drop-in element is configured via `createElement(...)`. Nothing in the pack shows official server-side or multi-language SDKs (e.g., Node, Python, Java); the CLI and MCP servers are separate tools and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented official server-side SDKs across languages, SDK reference docs/versioning, independent corroboration.
